fact: Car 18 forced Car 27 off the track at Turn 6.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, and in-car video evidence and determined that Car 18 did not force Car 27 off the track. Using the Driving Standard Guidelines as a point of reference, Car 18 clearly had its front axle at least alongside the mirror of the other car by the apex of the corner. The car was driven in a safe and controlled manner throughout the manoeuvre (entry, apex and exit) and did not, in our view, (deliberately) force the other car off the track at the exit. The line taken by Car 18 was a natural line for that corner and we could not expect Car 18, in these circumstances, to have taken a different line to create further space for Car 27. It also appears to us that Car 27 may have left the track briefly because the car bottomed out over the kerb. In the circumstances, we took no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 18 Alleged Forcing Car 27 Off The Track
